## Cite MOFography

This is the original MOFography paper(s), please cite it if you use MOFography in your work:

```{bib}
@article{mofography,
    title={Mofography: Advanced Characterization and Featurization of MOF Pores using Pore Graphs},
    author={Gopalan, Arun and Shi, Kaihang and Zheng, Chao and Azdapour, Behnam and Sarkisov, Lev},
    journal={TBD},
    year={TBD},
    publisher={TBD}
}

```
